blocks.html: I currently serve as a Case Manager at Dallas Detox Center. On a day-to-day basis, my role involves aftercare planning, legal assistance, and FMLA/STD for employment retention.

blocks.html: I love working at Dallas Detox Center because of the impactful work we do in helping individuals on their journey to recovery. Witnessing the positive transformations and providing support during challenging times is incredibly rewarding. The team’s commitment to making a difference in people’s lives makes each day fulfilling.

blocks.html: Working in the addiction treatment industry is a passion of mine because it allows me to contribute to a cause that goes beyond the professional realm. It’s about helping individuals overcome challenges, fostering resilience, and supporting them in rebuilding their lives. The sense of purpose and the opportunity to be part of positive change are what make this industry so special to me.

blocks.html: Professionally, I am most passionate about helping clients in direct care meet their goals and develop skills that will help them obtain long term sobriety. On a personal level, I am passionate about video games, going to the gym, and hanging out with my kids!
